Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Arun Kumar,Rahul Singh Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1.
Heard Meraj Ahmad Khan,learned cousnel for applicant, Sri Rahul Singh, learned cousnel for informant, Sri Sunil Kumar Srivastava, learned A.G.A. and perused the records.

2. The applicant has approached this Court by way of filing the present Criminal Misc. Bail Application seeking enlargement on bail in Case Crime No.212 of 2022, under Sections 323, 498A,
304-B I.P.C. & 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station-Hayat Nagar, District-Sambhal after rejection of his Bail Application vide order dated 14.2.2023 passed by learned Sessions Judge,
Sambhal at Chandausi.

3. Contents of prosecution story is extracted from the order dated 14.3.2023 passed by co-ordinate Bench in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.54957 of 2022, Satyawati Vs. State of U.P.
Mitthan vs State Of U.P. on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85867952/

"As per prosecution story, the marriage of the son of the applicant was solemnized with the sister of informant as per Hindu Rites and Rituals on 14.11.2021.

sentences.text: The applicant along with other co-accused are stated to have subjected the sister of informant to cruelty for a demand of dowry and as such leading her to death on 21.09.2022."

4. Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant is the father-in-law of deceased and has adopted the submissions made in support of bail application of co-accused that applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
5. Deceased was (daughter-in-law) of applicant and expired due to complications occurred at the time of delivery of her girl child on the date of occurrence.
Immediate cause of death was not ascertained and viscera was preserved.
However, according to viscera report, no poisonous substance was found.
Co-accused has already been granted bail.

6. Learned counsel for applicant lastly submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 20.1.2023, there is no likelihood of early disposal of trial and the applicant undertakes that if enlarged on bail, he will never misuse his liberty and will co-operate in the trial.
7.

Aforesaid submissions are opposed by learned counsel for informant and learned A.G.A. that applicant and other family members have not provided immediate medical assistance to deceased,
otherwise she could have alive today and there are evidence on record that applicant and other family members used to commit cruelty with deceased in regard to demand of a Bullet Motorcycle.
Deceased died within ten months of her marriage under otherwise than normal circumstances.
8. In the present case, applicant before this Court is father-in-law of deceased who died within 10 months of her marriage.

9. Statement of witnesses recorded during investigation indicates allegations of cruelty in regard to demand of dowry of Bullet Motorcycle, but it appears to be omnibus and general in nature and not specific towards any accused person.
10.
It has been brought on record that deceased has given birth to a girl child on the date of occurrence.
However, it appears that the applicant and other family members have not provided immediate requisite medical assistance to her.
However, while considering the nature of evidence required for the purpose of ingredients of dowry death i.e. harassment or cruelty for or in connection with, any demand for dowry.

However, it appears that allegations in regard to aforesaid factor appears to be omnibus and general in nature and since similarly situated co-accused, i.e mother-in-law has already been granted bail, applicant (father-in-law of deceased) is also entitled for bail.

2 11.

Let the applicant-Mitthan, be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence and will not harm or harass the victim/complainant in any manner whatsoever.
(ii) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the date fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in Court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(iii) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C., may be issued and if applicant fails to appear before the Court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then, the Trial Court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law, under section 174-A I.P.C.

(iv) The Trial Court may make all possible efforts/endeavour and try to conclude the trial expeditiously, preferably within a period of six months after release of the applicant, if there is no other legal impediment.

(v) Applicant has to appear on each and every date before learned Trial Court and any application for exemption of his appearance on vague ground could be a ground for cancellation of bail by learned Trial Court without even issuing notice.

12. The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.
13. The bail application is allowed.
14.
It is made clear that the observations made hereinabove are only for the purpose of adjudicating the present bail application.

Order Date:-18.5.2023 SB  Mitthan vs State Of U.P. on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85867952/
